findings.evidence: The cited Nayak et al. locator says §IV.A, PDF pp. 31–32, but §IV begins on PDF p. 52 and §IV.A is the ν=5/2 Qubits and Gates section. The Ising F matrix is Eq. 50 in §III.B.2, PDF p. 31; the absolute R phases are in §III.C.2, PDF p. 36 (their relative phase ratio is discussed in §III.B, PDF p. 32). Correcting the locator to those sections closes the citation defect; the supplier's data agree with them. This batch-28 supplier is outside this batch's edit scope.
